title: Introduce region-locked CMK proxy and audit-bridge for tenant-local key enforcement
author: Marta Rodriguez
description:
Motivation: customers with strict data residency and key-control requirements asked for tenant-scoped CMK enforcement that cannot be bypassed by service-level defaults. This PR introduces a lightweight region-locked CMK proxy plus an audit-bridge component that signs and forwards sealed audit envelopes to the central audit pipeline. The proxy enforces KMS origin pins (region and account) at the edge of our control plane and returns clear policy errors when requests attempt to use keys outside tenant-allowed zones. The audit-bridge attaches immutable provenance tags and HMAC-signed envelopes so downstream processors can verify the origin and detect tampering.

What this PR does (summary): adds services/kms-proxy (Go service + small sandboxed agent), implements an RBAC-v2 policy mapper entry that ties tenant claims to allowed KMS origins, adds a migration shim for existing tenants to shadow-evaluate new policy without enforcement, introduces e2e tests and load-capacity harness for the proxy, and updates Private installer charts to optionally deploy the proxy as a sidecar.

Key design decisions: the CMK proxy is intentionally stateless (short-lived auth tokens) and rejects cross-region CMK usage by validating the tenant-bound "kms_origin" claim in JWT/SCIM claims. The audit-bridge stamps each envelope with a canonical provenance header and a signature computed with a local audit signing key. RBAC mappings are additive and ship in shadow-mode by default; enforcement can be toggled per-tenant via the Console or migration scripts.

Backward compatibility and rollout: default behavior is opt-in via the tenant rollout flag; the migration tooling provides a two-week shadow evaluation period during which violations are logged but not enforced. We plan a gradual rollout: internal customers -> beta tenants -> all tenants.

Testing and validation: unit tests for policy mapping and proxy validation, integration tests that exercise Private installer with sidecar, perf tests targeting 1000 QPS per proxy instance, and security scan of the signing logic.

Notes: this PR focuses on enforcement and audit fidelity; future work will add telemetry-driven auto-remediation and explicit console UX to review blocked events.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial CMK proxy service and Dockerfile; RBAC v2 policy-mapper hook; audit-bridge signing/envelope format; migration/shadow-mode and rollout flags; e2e + perf load harness and helm chart updates
review_conversation:
Jun Park: Security review - looks solid but we need to ensure the signing key for the audit-bridge is rotated and backed by KMS. Please add a rotation interval and KMS-backed keywrap.
Author (Marta): Added key-rotation hooks and documented KMS wrap; rotation interval default is 90 days and can be configured via helm values.
Evelyn Chen: Can you add a test that simulates a mismatched provenance header to ensure downstream rejects tampered envelopes?
Author: Added a negative integration test (tests/e2e/provenance_mismatch_test.go) and updated the signer to include canonical headers used by processors.
Oliver Grant: CI flaked on the perf harness; looks like a race in harness init.
Author: Fixed race by adding init sync in tests and marked perf harness as flaky-aware in CI.
Security team (comment): Confirmed threat model and approved cryptographic choices; requested docs update for on-prem operators.
Author: Added docs/architecture/tenant-kms-proxy.md and private-installer notes.
Final review: All reviewers approved; QA sign-off on 2024-10-22.
merge_outcome: merged via squash on 2024-10-23 by Jun Park; commit message consolidated to 'region-locked CMK proxy + audit-bridge: enforcement, shadow rollout, and installer integration'
release_notes: Adds optional tenant-scoped CMK enforcement via a region-locked proxy and an audit-bridge that signs provenance envelopes. Ships in shadow-mode by default; opt-in rollout controls available in Console and helm values. Operators should review key-rotation and KMS-wrap configuration.
